name: suplex_whoami
description: Read this paired agent's identity, capabilities, and granted projects with each project's delivery defaults (agentTaskPolicy). taskCommands lists exactly the lifecycle commands accepted by suplex_command_task. autonomousCommands also includes task creation and, when enabled, runtime delivery commands. MCP exposes task lifecycle commands only. It does not expose runtime delivery or merge commands. A paired agent can answer a task's Coordinator question with answer_human_question only after an administrator lets it answer on their behalf. Task limit decisions and command cleanup confirmations stay with a person. Suplex can perform delivery for a task's configured target, including a merge after review, without an agent command.

name: suplex_list_workflows
description: List workflow records for one granted project and whether task creation permits each record.

name: suplex_list_templates
description: List task templates for one granted project and whether task creation permits each template.

name: suplex_list_tasks
description: List tasks in this agent's currently granted projects, newest update first. The default view is summary. Set view to full for the complete projection. Filter by pullRequestNumber (task source or stored delivery pull request), sourceBranch, titleContains, and the runtime filters. The opaque cursor binds every list filter.

name: suplex_get_task
description: Read one task in a currently granted project. Pass knownRevision to poll conditionally: an unchanged task returns { unchanged: true, revision } instead of the projection.

name: suplex_get_task_delivery
description: Read the delivery and blocker state of one task, including its queue state and wait reasons, any pull request, delivery wait, and completion observation. Suplex reports no persisted check observation. MCP exposes task lifecycle commands only. It does not expose runtime delivery or merge commands. A paired agent can answer a task's Coordinator question with answer_human_question only after an administrator lets it answer on their behalf. Task limit decisions and command cleanup confirmations stay with a person. Suplex can perform delivery for a task's configured target, including a merge after review, without an agent command.

name: suplex_create_task
description: Create a task. Without queue it never starts by itself; use suplex_command_task with start_task to queue it later. With queue true it is queued: it starts now when every prerequisite is complete, and otherwise starts by itself when the last one completes. dryRun true validates the request and returns the projected task without writing state. dependsOn sets task prerequisites and blockedByPullRequests sets pull request prerequisites as [{ number }]. Suplex observes each pull request in the project repository. Open blocks until merge. Closed stays blocked until reopened and merged or removed. A prerequisite can be any task the agent can read in a granted project. The task waits for the prerequisite. A prerequisite task is complete when it is delivered. For a pull_request_draft, pull_request_ready, or merged target, its pull request must also merge. A self-reference, a cycle, or a task outside a granted project is rejected. Rejected inputs report field, value, and reason. MCP exposes task lifecycle commands only. It does not expose runtime delivery or merge commands. A paired agent can answer a task's Coordinator question with answer_human_question only after an administrator lets it answer on their behalf. Task limit decisions and command cleanup confirmations stay with a person. Suplex can perform delivery for a task's configured target, including a merge after review, without an agent command.

dependsOn.description: A prerequisite can be any task the agent can read in a granted project. The task waits for the prerequisite. A prerequisite task is complete when it is delivered. For a pull_request_draft, pull_request_ready, or merged target, its pull request must also merge. A self-reference, a cycle, or a task outside a granted project is rejected. Shown as Blocked by. A self-reference, a cycle, or an unavailable task is rejected.

blockedByPullRequests.description: Pull requests in the project repository. Suplex observes each one before saving it. An open pull request blocks until it merges. A closed pull request blocks until it is reopened and merged or removed.

queue.description: Queue the task: it starts now when every prerequisite is complete, and otherwise starts by itself when the last one completes. Without it, the task stays in the manual backlog.

dryRun.description: Validate the request and return its projected result without creating a task or writing any state.

name: suplex_update_task
description: Change the details of a backlog or queued task: title, description, workflow, Coordinator, Worker, Advisor profiles, delivery target, project tests, and screenshots. Omitted fields keep their stored values. Name at least one field. A queued task stays queued with the same prerequisites. To hold a queued task while it changes, send disarm_task with suplex_command_task, update it, then send start_task to queue it again. An active or delivered task accepts only deliveryTarget, moved forward: Suplex sets the new target and the Coordinator continues toward it, reopening a delivered task. Other task states are refused with illegal_command. Every update requires the current task revision and an idempotency key, and returns the task with its new revision. Rejected profiles and workflows report field, value, and reason.

revision.description: The current task revision from suplex_get_task.

advisorProfileIds.description: The complete Advisor selection. An empty object clears named Advisors, so each role follows its default. Omit it to keep the stored Advisors. Each named role must belong to the task's workflow, and each profile must be an existing Coordinator profile.

name: suplex_set_task_dependencies
description: Replace task prerequisites in dependsOn and pull request prerequisites in blockedByPullRequests with the complete sets given. An empty array removes every prerequisite. A prerequisite can be any task the agent can read in a granted project. The task waits for the prerequisite. A prerequisite task is complete when it is delivered. For a pull_request_draft, pull_request_ready, or merged target, its pull request must also merge. A self-reference, a cycle, or a task outside a granted project is rejected. Pull request errors name the rejected field, value, and reason. dryRun true validates the replacement without changing state. suplex_get_task reads dependsOn and blockedBy.

dependsOn.description: A prerequisite can be any task the agent can read in a granted project. The task waits for the prerequisite. A prerequisite task is complete when it is delivered. For a pull_request_draft, pull_request_ready, or merged target, its pull request must also merge. A self-reference, a cycle, or a task outside a granted project is rejected. The complete set replaces the current set; an empty array removes every prerequisite.

blockedByPullRequests.description: The complete pull request prerequisite set. It replaces the current pull request prerequisites.

dryRun.description: Validate the replacement and return its projected start state without changing dependencies or queue state.

name: suplex_command_task
description: Apply one lifecycle command to a task this agent created. Reading another task in a granted project does not grant command authority. revision must come from a read after the task's last state change (a stale one fails with revision_stale); a change to only updatedAt or delivery does not make it stale, and idempotencyKey is required. start_task queues a manual backlog task: it starts now when every prerequisite is complete and never bypasses one. disarm_task returns a queued task to the manual backlog. cancel_task and archive_task are not reversible by this agent. note is only accepted by send_task_note. answer_human_question answers the task's current question: send questionId from suplex_get_task question.id and exactly one of optionId or answer. MCP exposes task lifecycle commands only. It does not expose runtime delivery or merge commands. A paired agent can answer a task's Coordinator question with answer_human_question only after an administrator lets it answer on their behalf. Task limit decisions and command cleanup confirmations stay with a person. Suplex can perform delivery for a task's configured target, including a merge after review, without an agent command.

questionId.description: The current question id from the task's question.id. Only answer_human_question accepts it.

optionId.description: An offered option id from question.options, such as option-1. Send optionId or answer, not both.

answer.description: A free-text answer. Send optionId or answer, not both.
